name: updateSettings
description: Changes the media center's settings and design, keeping every setting not given.

description.description: The formatted text shown above the media list. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

carouselImages.description: The carousel above the media list, in order, each an image and what tapping it does. Replaces the current images; pass an empty list to remove them all.

mediaSortOrder.description: How the media list is ordered. Leave it out to keep the current order.

categorySortOrder.description: How the categories are ordered. Leave it out to keep the current order.

allowShare.description: Whether people can share media. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

allowFavorites.description: Whether people can keep favorites. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

allowAddingNotes.description: Whether people can add personal notes. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

allowSource.description: Whether the media source link is shown. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

allowOfflineDownload.description: Whether people can download media for offline use. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

enableFiltering.description: Whether people can filter media by category. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

showViewCount.description: Whether view counts are shown. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

indicatePlayedItems.description: Whether played items are highlighted. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

globalPlaylist.description: Whether people can add media to their playlist; always off while auto-add all audio is on. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

showGlobalAddAllToPlaylistButton.displayName: Enable add all to global playlist button
showGlobalAddAllToPlaylistButton.description: Whether the add-all-to-playlist button is shown. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

showGlobalPlaylistNavButton.displayName: Enable navigate to global playlist button
showGlobalPlaylistNavButton.description: Whether the go-to-playlist button is shown. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

autoPlay.description: Whether the next item plays on its own; always off while auto-add all audio is on. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

autoPlayDelay.description: The pause before the next item plays. Leave it out to keep the current pause.

shuffleAudioListItems.description: Whether the list is shuffled while playing; always off while continuous playback is off. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

forceAutoPlay.description: Whether all audio is added to the player's playlist. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

startWithAutoJumpByDefault.description: Whether playback resumes from the last position; always off while auto-add all audio is off. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

skipMediaPage.description: Whether tapping an item skips its info page. Leave it out to keep the current setting.

listLayout.description: The layout of the media list. Leave it out to keep the current one.

itemLayout.description: The layout of a media item's page. Leave it out to keep the current one.

backgroundImage.description: The background image, as a list holding one image. Leave it out to keep the current one, or pass an empty list to remove it.

callback.description: Runs when the settings are saved.

error.description: Why nothing was changed, such as no setting being given.

descriptionHTML.description: The text shown above the media list.

images.description: The carousel shown above the media list.

items.description: One carousel image and what tapping it does.

sortBy.description: How the media list is ordered.

allowAddingNotes.description: Whether people can add personal notes.

allowSource.description: Whether the media source link is shown.

allowOfflineDownload.description: Whether people can download media for offline use.

enableFiltering.description: Whether people can filter media by category.

globalPlaylist.description: Whether people can add media to their playlist.

showGlobalAddAllToPlaylistButton.description: Whether the add-all-to-playlist button is shown.

showGlobalPlaylistNavButton.description: Whether the go-to-playlist button is shown.

autoPlay.description: Whether the next item plays on its own.

autoPlayDelay.description: The pause before the next item plays.

shuffleAudioListItems.description: Whether the list is shuffled while playing.

forceAutoPlay.description: Whether all audio is added to the player's playlist.

startWithAutoJumpByDefault.description: Whether playback resumes from the last position.

design.description: The look of the media list and pages.

listLayout.description: The layout of the media list.

itemLayout.description: The layout of a media item's page.

skipMediaPage.description: Whether tapping an item skips its info page.
